scope: Module-level semantic matrix of every top-level area (947 tracked files). Studied for episode/fact/provenance/history continuity useful to commerce evidence.

rows.behaviour: Zep Community Edition server: Postgres store, REST API handlers, telemetry, config
rows.reason: deprecated CE server over Postgres; ECDEV owns its SQLite run store and MCP/HTTP server

rows.behaviour: episode text/type/source timestamp validation; RFC3339 with mandatory offset; scalar-only metadata; non-finite rejection
rows.reason: ECDEV Evidence::validate requires provider, source layer, timestamps and raw hash; adapter/web/src/social.rs::published rejects naive datetimes; price and JSON paths reject non-finite numbers

rows.behaviour: fact edge with valid_at/invalid_at/created_at, SCREAMING_SNAKE fact names, at most one label per node, UUID pinning
rows.reason: domain/commerce/src/memory.rs::Validity and monitor watch_facts carry validity windows; ECDEV edges are typed by its own vocabulary; identity pinning is ECDEV's assertion-based resolution

rows.behaviour: rewrite or annotate entity aliases before ingestion with a risky-word guard
rows.reason: rewriting source text would alter evidence; ECDEV keeps raw text and proposes uncertain links instead (memory::match_names)

rows.behaviour: chunking for LLM ingestion, Slack/transcript/JSON loaders, batched submission to Zep Cloud, task polling
rows.reason: exists to feed the managed Zep Cloud API; ECDEV performs no LLM ingestion and has no Zep Cloud dependency
ECDEV exposes its own MCP server; no managed memory service
documentation of a paid managed service

rows.source: integrations/ (ADK, LiveKit, CrewAI, Mastra, Vercel AI, AG2, AutoGen, LangGraph, PydanticAI, Strands, MS Agent Framework)
rows.reason: ECDEV is reached by agents through MCP, not framework plugins
measure chat memory recall, not commerce evidence

rows.behaviour: default entity/edge types for Zep Cloud
rows.reason: ECDEV's ontology is its own evidence and commerce vocabulary

conclusion: Every provenance property ECDEV needs from this repository is already native (timezone-required timestamps, validity windows, raw-hash provenance, non-finite rejection); the remainder serves the managed Zep Cloud service or chat-memory benchmarks. Nothing is adopted, no package is depended on and no edge was ever observed, so the donor is REJECTED (evaluated, never adopted).
knowledge_superseded: NOT_RELEVANT_TO_ECDEV and REJECTED in this file are runtime-adoption decisions only. Knowledge value is decided per capability in .ecdev/declared/donors.rs and summarised in research/commerce/donor-reaudit.json and research/commerce/governance/knowledge.json

file_coverage.rule: every FIRST_PARTY_SOURCE path in the census files.jsonl matches the first prefix below; checked by tools/commerce/validate.py --records-only
file_coverage.method: read-only whole-source review: ingestion/src, zep-eval-harness, benchmarks, mcp and ontology read in full; integrations, examples and legacy per directory; the correlation block, the skipped LoCoMo category 5 and the unscored needles were spot-checked

whole_source_findings: zep-eval-harness scores context completeness (COMPLETE/PARTIAL/INSUFFICIENT with missing elements) before answer accuracy and correlates them, separating retrieval failure from generation failure; line-level needles are recorded but never scored, and responder and judge are one model
The LoCoMo budget sweep plateaus near 1.4k context tokens (accuracy 0.696 at 347 tokens, 0.801 at 1378, 0.803 at 1998)
LoCoMo skips the adversarial category and LongMemEval has no abstention judge: abstention evidence is weak; the knowledge-update and temporal judges are the assets
Ingestion transforms hold real algorithms (boundary-aware and valid-JSON splitting, LLM situating context that fails open); integrations are pure adapters
